title: RFC 4949: Internet Security Glossary, Version 2
author: R. Shirey (IETF)
purpose: 標準術語定義（plaintext、ciphertext、encryption、key、symmetric / asymmetric cryptography 等）

title: Handbook of Applied Cryptography, Chapter 1: Overview of Cryptography
author: A. Menezes, P. van Oorschot, S. Vanstone (CRC Press; hosted by University of Waterloo CACR)
purpose: 大學教材：密碼學目標、基本術語、對稱式加密、替換與換位密碼、公開金鑰概念

title: Handbook of Applied Cryptography, Chapter 7: Block Ciphers
author: A. Menezes, P. van Oorschot, S. Vanstone (CRC Press; hosted by University of Waterloo CACR)
purpose: 大學教材：古典密碼與其弱點、區塊加密的操作模式（ECB、CBC 等）

title: FIPS 197 (Update 1): Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)
author: NIST
purpose: AES 官方標準：區塊大小、金鑰長度、輪數、輪函數

title: NIST SP 800-38A: Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: Methods and Techniques
author: M. Dworkin (NIST)
purpose: ECB、CBC、CTR 等操作模式的官方定義與 IV／計數器要求

title: NIST SP 800-175B Rev. 1: Guideline for Using Cryptographic Standards in the Federal Government: Cryptographic Mechanisms
author: E. Barker (NIST)
purpose: 對稱與非對稱機制概覽、金鑰建立與金鑰管理的現代觀點

title: New Directions in Cryptography
author: W. Diffie, M. E. Hellman (IEEE Trans. Information Theory; hosted by Stanford)
purpose: 公開金鑰密碼學與金鑰交換概念的原始論文

title: A Method for Obtaining Digital Signatures and Public-Key Cryptosystems
author: R. L. Rivest, A. Shamir, L. Adleman (Communications of the ACM; hosted by MIT)
purpose: RSA 原始論文：金鑰產生、加解密、數位簽章

title: RFC 8017: PKCS #1: RSA Cryptography Specifications Version 2.2
author: K. Moriarty, B. Kaliski, J. Jonsson, A. Rusch (IETF)
purpose: RSA 現行標準：RSA 公鑰／私鑰定義、RSAES-OAEP、RSASSA-PSS

title: RFC 8446: The Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.3
author: E. Rescorla (IETF)
purpose: 現代網路應用：TLS 1.3 的金鑰交換、憑證簽章與 AEAD 加密

title: NIST SP 800-38D: Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) and GMAC
author: M. Dworkin (NIST)
purpose: GCM（以 CTR 為基礎的認證加密），銜接 CTR 與 TLS 1.3

title: NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev. 5: Recommendation for Key Management: Part 1 – General
author: E. Barker (NIST)
purpose: 現行金鑰強度建議（例如 AES 與 RSA 金鑰長度對應的安全強度）

title: The Joy of Cryptography
author: Mike Rosulek (Oregon State University)
purpose: 大學部教科書：看大學課程如何從零介紹 XOR、mod、區塊加密與操作模式（教學法參考＋名詞定義）

title: Crypto 101
author: Laurens Van Houtven
purpose: 入門書：看入門教材如何安排主題順序（先 XOR、再區塊加密、再操作模式）（教學法參考）

title: What is encryption? | Cloudflare Learning Center
author: Cloudflare
purpose: 科技公司給一般大眾的說明：看業界如何用白話介紹加密、金鑰、對稱與非對稱（教學法參考）
